title: Flutter 3.44 Released with Agentic Hot Reload & GenUI
summary: Google releases Flutter 3.44 at Google I/O 2026, introducing Agentic Hot Reload for AI assistants and a new Generative UI framework for dynamic layout adapters.

title: Apple TV+ Premieres Spinoff 'Star City'
summary: The highly anticipated 'For All Mankind' spinoff 'Star City' premieres to critical acclaim, detailing the alternate-history space race from the Soviet space program's perspective.

title: Genkit for Dart Introduced
summary: Firebase announces Genkit Dart, letting developers build AI-powered agentic apps in Dart with support for Gemini, Anthropic, and OpenAI.
